ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio dominated by low-intensity (near-black) pixels with approximately 5-10% coverage of high-intensity (white) pixels representing scars and markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-pixel base; high-intensity white blobs located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; a central white cluster near the peduncle attachment; numerous high-contrast linear segments distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 100 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with frequent peaks and valleys; serrations are more pronounced and jagged on the right lobe distal edge compared to the smoother peaks on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a gentle convex curve from the central notch towards the tips, terminating in a sharp, upward-tapered distal sweep on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of textured, high-intensity circular pixel aggregates at both the left and right fluke tips, suggesting heavy barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned linear white streaks (rake marks) varying in length from 10 to 180 pixels, primarily concentrated on the inner-mid regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring across the ventral surface and calcified textured clusters at the distal extremities.
